outcome.Summary: Implemented the spec'd expression language in package `expr` (directory expr/): lexer.go (numbers incl. exponents, identifiers, true/false, all operators, `unexpected character 'X'` at byte offset; exponent overflow like 1e999 yields ±Inf for the runtime non-finite check), ast.go (float64 AST with math.Mod/%, math.Pow/^, 1/0 booleans, short-circuit &&/||/?:), parser.go (recursive descent matching all 10 precedence levels: right-assoc ternary, `^` right-assoc with unary right operand so -2^2=-4, 2^-1=0.5, 2^3^2=512; compile-time unknown-function/arity errors at the name), expr.go (Error with "<Pos>: <Msg>", Program with Eval/Vars, Compile, Eval; runtime errors for division by zero, unknown variables, sqrt of negative, non-finite result at pos 0). Wrote expr/expr_test.go with ~90 cases covering values, all error messages/positions, short-circuiting, Vars and program reuse. Verified: `go vet ./... && go test ./...` exits 0; code is gofmt-clean and committed.
